description: This file defines a custom exception class `Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Exception` used in the Zend Framework's plugin loader component. It requires the general Zend_Loader_Exception class and extends it to specify exceptions related to plugin class loading failures.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Exception
classes.description: Exception class for plugin loader errors, extending Zend_Loader_Exception to denote errors specifically in plugin class loading within the Zend Framework.
